dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,5)>Now, I’d really love to make the <$cdef(27)>fourth floor someplace
glitzy and fancy. Y’know, for prim ’n’ proper sorts.
<$voicel(2,3)>But I don’t really know anything about actin’ proper or
fancy or anything like that...

<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)>Do you know a Pokémon who could help us out,
<$cdef(27)>?
They
gotta
be
all
prim
’n’
proper-like?

<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,665)><$voicel(2,7)>What? There’s a <$cdef(27)>prim ’n’ proper Pikachu in the town near
the sea?
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>Well then, I’d sure love to meet ’em!

<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,665)><$voicel(2,7)>What? There’s a <$cdef(27)>prim ’n’ proper Pikachu in the town near
the sea?
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>Well then, I’d sure love to meet ’em!

<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,5)>So yeah, if you could maybe <$emotion(2,50)><$voicel(2,10)>invite that <$cdef(27)>fancy Pikachu to
join us, it’d make me real happy!

<$comeff(2,3)><$voicel(2,6)>Oh, and y’know how we need <$cdef(27)><$ifull(126)> for our repair
materials, yeah?
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,9)>I bet a Pokémon like <$cdef(27)>Metang could help us with that by
recycling <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1801)>!

<$emotion(2,50)><$voicel(2,9)>This is the last part of the building! Time to rebuild the
<$cdef(27)>fourth floor!

<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,7)>Could ya get <$cdef(27)>Peakychu to join us while you’re out there
gathering materials?

<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,5)>You’ll need to recycle <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1801)> if ya wanna get your
hands on some <$cdef(27)><$ifull(126)>!
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,8)>I bet a Pokémon like <$cdef(27)>Metang would know all about that
sorta thing.

<$emotion(3,14)><$voicel(3,5)>Oh, if it isn’t <$cdef(27)>! How lovely to
see
you.
Do
you
need
me
for something?
<$comeff(3,5)><$motion(3,665)><$voicel(3,9)>Gracious me! You’re reconstructing a large building ONLY
with the help of other Pokémon?
<$emotion(3,38)><$voicel(3,7)>Pii-hee! You never stop doing amazing things, do you?
And that’s what makes YOU so amazing.

<$comeff(3,9)><$motion(3,664)><$voicel(3,9)>I’m not quite sure how I would be able to help, but I’m
happy to tag along regardless!
<$comeff(3,10)><$facial(3,4)><$motion(3,803)><$voicel(3,7)>Well then, please guide me to the construction site.

<$emotion(3,60)><$voicel(3,7)>What kind of building is it, I wonder? Please lead the way
to the construction site!

<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, you must be that prim ’n’ proper <$cdef(27)>Pikachu I’ve heard
all about!
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>Thanks for makin’ your way all the way out here. Musta
been exhausting!

<$comeff(3,10)><$facial(3,4)><$motion(3,661)><$voicel(3,5)>Erm, I don’t know that I appreciate being called “prim and
proper”... I’m tougher than I look—I assure you!
Well then, no time like the present. <$comeff(3,6)><$motion(3,666)><$voicel(3,8)>How may I help?

<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,9)>Whoa, sorry ’bout that! I wasn’t tryin’ to say you’re weak
or anything! <$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,8)>We’re counting on your help once we start
work on the <$cdef(27)>fourth floor!

<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>Awesome, we’re set to get crackin’ on the <$cdef(27)>fourth floor!
Leave the rest to me ’n’ my happy helpers!
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>This’ll take a while. Come check on us later!
<$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,7)>The <$cdef(27)>fourth floor</color> isn’t quite ready yet! Come back later!

<$comeff(2,13)><$motion(2,659)><$voicel(2,9)>We did it! We all worked together and totally fixed up this
big building!

<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)><$cdef(27)>! All of you! Thanks so much
for
helpin’
me out!
<$emotion(2,50)><$voicel(2,10)>I had a blast!

<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>So it’s finally finished, is it? That’s quite the feat for
Pokémon alone to accomplish!
<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,10)>I had a lot of fun too!
<$comeff(3,21)><$facial(3,4)><$motion(3,801)><$voicel(3,10)>It really has become quite a magnificent building!

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Hohoho! Well then, what are we waiting for? Let’s take a
look inside, <$cdef(27)>!
<$voicel(3,4)>Oh my! Wh-what was that just now?
This building... What is happening here?
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>What the heck’s that voice? I hear it comin’ from above!
<$comeff(4,5)><$facial(4,13)><$motion(4,665)><$voicel(4,9)>Oh, my! There’s something very odd happening in the sky!

<$voicel(1,9)>I believe someone was moving on the <$cdef(27)>roof just now!
<$voicel(1,7)><$cdef(27)>! Will you please go check the
<$cdef(27)>roof
of
this building?
<$voicel(1,5)>It might be a Pokémon we haven’t met before!

<$voicel(2,9)>Please, <$cdef(27)>! Do it for me!
<$voicel(2,7)>I’d be crushed if anything happened to this beautiful
building we just finished!
